# utils

**In one sentence:** Tiny constant lists and formatters for the VAE Review screen: the keep/drop decisions, the four image views, and number formatting.

## Why it exists
The cards and the detail panel both need the same decision list and view list. Keeping them here means both parts show the same options.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `decisions.js` | `VAE_DECISIONS` (`keep` = "Keep Input", `drop` = "Drop Input"), `normalizeVaeDecision` (any unknown value becomes `keep`) and `optionForVaeDecision`. |
| `views.js` | `VAE_VIEWS`, the four pictures shown per image: `original`, `vae` (the image after a VAE round trip), `diff` (where they differ) and `hard` (a hard-threshold mask of the differences). `normalizeVaeView` falls back to `original` when the image has no picture for the requested view. |
| `format.js` | `formatDimensions` ("1024x768" or "unknown size") and `formatNumber` (up to 5 decimals, trailing zeros removed, "n/a" for missing values). |

## Who uses it
- `../vae_review.js` (`normalizeVaeDecision`), `../components/card.js`, `../components/detail.js`.
- Tests: `tests/ui/static/vae_review.test.js`.
